research_scope: Research Galick Gun after repository search found no existing Galick Gun research record. Only directly supported acquisition, classification, resource cost, and core mechanics are promoted.

verification_audit.source_policy: The repository search returned no existing Galick Gun record. Current Xenoverse 2 reference material and an independent historical skill reference agree on Vegeta training as the acquisition route and 100 Ki cost. No Ultimate Finish requirement is inferred.
verification_audit.correction_note: The original batch asserted ultimate_finish_required=false without explicit negative-Ultimate-Finish evidence. That certainty has been removed; the field is now null so the record follows the repository's negative-evidence policy.

records.name: Galick Gun
records.skill_description: A chargeable Ki Blast beam Super that can be fired at three charge stages.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material classifies Galick Gun as a beam and chargeable Ki Blast Super costing 100 Ki. It can be charged to three stages; the reference describes ideal-condition hit counts of 9, 12, and 15 respectively. It also notes that a fully charged version can teleport the user in front of the target when using a Super Saiyan Awoken Skill variant. Exact damage values are not promoted as canonical in this batch.
records.combo_notes: The shorter charge time relative to Kamehameha can make Galick Gun useful after knockback. Multi-hit behavior can be affected by evasive actions or connection conditions.
